summary: All 11 'Other' items are protein-powder supplements: a parent 'protein-powder' plus 10 source-specific children (beef, casein, collagen, egg, hemp, mixed-plant, pea, rice, soy, whey), all parented to 'protein-powder', all stored Pantry with 365/730-day freshness and identical facets/swaps. This is a coherent, well-formed family. Protein powder is a sports-nutrition / supplement TYPE that has no clean home in the 18 categories: it is not a whole-food (Protein holds meat/fish/tofu/tempeh/seitan), not a Beverage, and not Dairy (the 'whey' there is the dairy by-product, not the supplement). RECOMMENDATION: leave the whole family in 'Other' — it is the correct catch-all here, not a misfile. The one real defect is data, not placement: 'collagen' is tagged Vegan but collagen is exclusively animal-derived. No items belong in a real category; no missing category is implied (a dedicated 'Supplements' category would be the only candidate but is out of scope for 18).

issues.issue: Tagged 'Vegan' AND 'Dairy-Free', but collagen protein is exclusively animal-derived (bovine/marine/porcine). It is not even Vegetarian. dietaryTags are wrong.
Animal-derived collagen should carry an allergen if marine-sourced (fish), and at minimum must not claim Vegan/Vegetarian. allergens is currently null.

Marked 'Vegetarian' which is correct for whey, but note potential confusion with the separate 'whey' family in Dairy & Eggs (acid/isolate/hydrolysate whey) — these are distinct (dairy by-product vs supplement). Not a defect, flagged for reviewer awareness only.
No allergens listed; beef-derived is fine, but it is animal-derived so 'Vegetarian' is correctly absent — consistent. No fix needed, noted for completeness.
